title: Grateful Dead Live at Indianapolis State Fair Coliseum on 1973-10-27
lineage: MSR > R > C > D > CD  patched with MAC > ? > D

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording clears up after the first tunes, delivering crisp audio of a high‑energy 1973 Indianapolis show highlighted by smoking Truckin', incendiary China > Rider and Keith’s stellar keyboard work.
ai_review.review: The performance is widely praised for its fire‑filled setlist – standout moments include a dirty Truckin', an explosive China > Rider transition, the Big River → Playin' reprise, Loose Lucy and a killer Beat It On Down The Line keyboard solo.  The SBD source is a bit muddied at the very start and suffers occasional drop‑outs near the end, but for most of the concert the mix is clear, bright and well balanced.

ai_rating.rationale: Average reviewer rating is 4.6/5; comments describe a strong musical show (≈4.7) with generally good but not flawless sound quality (≈4.0). Weighted average yields ~4.5.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Initial muddiness and a few drop‑outs early on; improves by the second tune and stays clear/bright for most of the set. Noted source switch from SBD to AUD during Wharf Rat adds brief inconsistency.

standout_songs: Beat It On Down The Line
show_quality.setlist_flow: Smooth transitions with highlighted jams (China>Rider, Big River→Playin') and a strong second set; the crowd’s enthusiasm fuels an energetic pacing throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Multiple reviewers note Jerry “smokin’”, extra chops and perfect tone, especially on Truckin' and other jams.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s playing is repeatedly praised – “bangs on the keys like there’s no tomorrow” and his solo on Beat It On Down The Line called the best ever.
